feature_contract.goal: Prevent incomplete binocular R84 frames after left-eye Draw or unrecoverable left-eye WVP rollback failures for both fast world geometry and gameplay HUD; keep safe lower-renderer fallback intact.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only R84 R33 FastWorld/HUD left-eye failure publication safety; preserve successful eyes, R30/R29 fallback, right-eye restore handling, SkyGlow, native input, DX11 and frozen DXVK.
feature_contract.special_work_evidence: R30 R29OwnerMarkRightDrawFailed is present in failed-left submission and failed-rollback branches; R84 R33 had no matching R32ReviewMarkFrameRightDrawFailed in its four corresponding branches, allowing current-Present completion state to outlive a partial eye failure.
trace_stages: Original game's D3D9 world/HUD draws enter R33 physical DrawPrimitive and DrawIndexed owner and choose per-eye fast-world or HUD c64 uploads.
A failed left draw or impossible original c64 rollback bypasses the right-eye draw and previously armed future mono safety without revoking the current Present's frame-right validity.
R29 FrameRightDrawFailed is consumed by existing Present/stereo/DirectGPU publication gating; mark it before poisoning the failed draw in both R84 paths.
subcomponents: Veto the current Present in FastWorld on failed left Draw and irrecoverable c64 rollback.
Veto the current Present in ScreenHUD on identical failure paths while allowing clean WVP rollback to fall through to R29.
Enforce branch-local source contracts and destructive mutation checks for failure and safe fallthrough.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: R84 FastWorld original game depth/WVP and left eye
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Every unrecoverable left-WVP rollback or failed FastWorld left draw sets FrameRightDrawFailed before recovery/return and preserves native HRESULT.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: R84 gameplay HUD left eye plus R29 fallback and desktop
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: HUD equivalent failure paths veto current Present; a successful rollback still falls through to lower R29 and unrelated SkyGlow/right-eye logic remains unchanged.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Win32 R84 game, R26_SAFE, x64 OpenXR host and release package
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Source-mutation regressions and exact-SHA GitHub DX9Ex Active/Domain/affected Inspector or Full Source pass, HMD acceptance stays separate.

diagnosis.original_evidence: The R30 HUD lower stereo failure route marks current FrameRightDrawFailed before both failed-left Draw and unrecoverable WVP rollback; R33FastWorld and R33Hud did not set this flag on those same failure paths.
diagnosis.root_cause: R84 split dispatch retained future mono safety and R9Poison reporting but omitted the current frame-right validity latch on left-eye failure; the latch is needed independently of recovery.
source_trace: D3D9 original draw arrives in R33Dispatch FastWorld or screenHUD.
Failed left c64 upload with failed rollback and failed left actualDraw follow two separate early returns in each route.
R29 FrameRightDrawFailed downstream guards delivery of complete stereo frames.
alternatives_rejected: Do not skip normal right-eye rendering, assume a later recovery arm repairs the already-captured present, or globally suppress alpha/SkyGlow/desktop presentation.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Four R84 physical failure branches mark current frame invalid prior to poison/return, while clean WVP rollback still returns to lower R29.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Extended existing tools/verify_vr_stereo_restore_publication.py with 10 targeted negative source mutations; exact-SHA CI pending.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: Only complete left/right physical submissions may be exposed as one DirectGPU/OpenXR stereo frame; R29 receives explicit invalid-right-frame latch if left is not valid.
diagnosis.evidence_limits: No Quest3/VDXR hardware run; Windows exact-SHA CI requested through normal branch push.
